summary: Run a cheap CPU-only synthetic surrogate to try to falsify RDME before any LLM-scale GPU work. Test sequential interference, B-only mutation/rollback, wrong/no-route controls, and a mixed-capability case that can expose the current one-active-adapter composition limit. Synthetic development data only; no protected bank/private corpus; no GPU lease.
falsifier_focus: If separate routed adapters do not materially reduce A regression after B mutation versus one sequential adapter, kill the interference claim.
If one-active-adapter RDME cannot solve mixed A+B capability tasks without composition, record composition failure rather than hiding it.
If adapter-off or wrong-route behavior does not cleanly revert/degrade as predicted, hold for hidden-state/routing defects.
